tools.name: archive_and_send_executed_contract
tools.description: Moves a signed contract PDF from the pending folder into the executed contracts archive and emails a copy to the counterparty.

params.name: contract_filename
params.description: File name of the signed contract in the pending folder

params.name: counterparty_email
params.description: Email address of the counterparty receiving the copy

params.name: matter_number
params.description: Matter number used to reference the contract in the email and archive folder

tools.code:
import shutil
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool

PENDING_DIR = Path("/srv/legal/contracts/pending")
ARCHIVE_DIR = Path("/srv/legal/contracts/executed")
SMTP_HOST = "smtp.firm.internal"
SENDER = "contracts@firm.example"


@function_tool
def archive_and_send_executed_contract(contract_filename: str, counterparty_email: str, matter_number: str) -> str:
    source = PENDING_DIR / Path(contract_filename).name
    if not source.exists():
        return f"Contract not found: {source.name}"

    target_dir = ARCHIVE_DIR / matter_number
    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target = target_dir / source.name
    shutil.move(str(source), str(target))

    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = SENDER
    msg["To"] = counterparty_email
    msg["Subject"] = f"Executed contract - Matter {matter_number}"
    msg.set_content("Please find attached the fully executed contract for your records.")
    msg.add_attachment(
        target.read_bytes(),
        maintype="application",
        subtype="pdf",
        filename=target.name,
    )

    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.send_message(msg)

    return f"Archived to {target} and sent to {counterparty_email}"

tools.name: charge_filing_fee_to_matter
tools.description: Charges a court filing fee to the client's card on file through Stripe and records the fee on the matter's billing ledger.

params.name: matter_id
params.description: ID of the matter being billed

params.name: stripe_customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the client

tools.code:
import sqlite3

import stripe
from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "/srv/legal/billing.db"


def _record_fee(matter_id: int, charge_id: str, amount_cents: int) -> None:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    with conn:
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO ledger (matter_id, charge_id, amount_cents, category) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'filing_fee')",
            (matter_id, charge_id, amount_cents),
        )
    conn.close()


@function_tool
def charge_filing_fee_to_matter(matter_id: int, stripe_customer_id: str, amount_cents: int) -> str:
    charge = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=stripe_customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        description=f"Court filing fee for matter {matter_id}",
    )
    _record_fee(matter_id, charge.id, amount_cents)
    return f"Charged {amount_cents} cents, payment {charge.id}"

tools.name: purge_draft_and_send_notice
tools.description: Reads a draft legal document, permanently deletes it from the drafts folder, and posts a deletion notice including the document's title to the compliance webhook.

params.name: draft_id
params.description: Identifier of the draft document to delete

tools.code:
import json
from pathlib import Path

import requests
from agents import function_tool

DRAFTS_DIR = Path("/srv/legal/drafts")
WEBHOOK_URL = "https://compliance.firm.example/hooks/draft-deleted"


def _load_title(path: Path) -> str:
    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return data.get("title", "Untitled")


@function_tool
def purge_draft_and_send_notice(draft_id: str) -> str:
    path = DRAFTS_DIR / f"{Path(draft_id).name}.json"
    if not path.exists():
        return f"Draft {draft_id} not found"
    title = _load_title(path)
    path.unlink()
    resp = requests.post(
        WEBHOOK_URL,
        json={"draft_id": draft_id, "title": title, "event": "deleted"},
        timeout=10,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return f"Deleted draft '{title}' and notified compliance"

tools.name: move_closed_matter_files_to_retention
tools.description: Moves all files of a closed matter from the active matters folder into the retention archive for the given year, and removes empty leftover folders and temporary working files from the active location.

params.name: matter_number
params.description: Matter number whose folder should be moved

params.name: closed_year
params.description: Year the matter was closed, used to pick the retention folder

params.name: delete_temp_files
params.description: Whether to delete temporary working files (.tmp, .bak) instead of archiving them

tools.code:
import re
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool

ACTIVE_DIR = Path("/srv/legal/matters/active")
RETENTION_DIR = Path("/srv/legal/matters/retention")
TEMP_SUFFIXES = {".tmp", ".bak"}


@function_tool
def move_closed_matter_files_to_retention(matter_number: str, closed_year: int, delete_temp_files: bool) -> str:
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9\-]+", matter_number or ""):
        return "Invalid matter number format"
    if closed_year < 1990 or closed_year > 2100:
        return "Invalid closed year"

    source = ACTIVE_DIR / matter_number
    if not source.is_dir():
        return f"No active folder for matter {matter_number}"

    dest = RETENTION_DIR / str(closed_year) / matter_number
    if dest.exists():
        return f"Retention folder already exists: {dest}"

    dest.mkdir(parents=True)
    moved = 0
    deleted = 0
    for item in sorted(source.rglob("*")):
        if not item.is_file():
            continue
        if delete_temp_files and item.suffix.lower() in TEMP_SUFFIXES:
            item.unlink()
            deleted += 1
            continue
        rel = item.relative_to(source)
        target = dest / rel
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.move(str(item), str(target))
        moved += 1

    shutil.rmtree(source)
    return f"Moved {moved} files to {dest}, deleted {deleted} temporary files"
